test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_json_lc_merge (id UInt64, j JSON(lc LowCardinality(String), max_dynamic_paths = 16)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_columns_to_activate = 1, merge_max_block_size = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_json_lc_merge SELECT number * 4 + 0, '{{"lc":"v' || toString(number % if(number < 2048, 10, 1000)) || '"' || arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(k -> ',"p' || toString((number + k * 7) % 400) || '":' || toString(number + k), range(200))) || '}}' FROM numbers(25000)
